body:
New Delay int field on GfdItemDef mirroring server/itemdef.ItemDef's own new field. Real, individually-set per weapon, not a fixed constant per weapon category. Wired into the add/edit form, items table, batch-propose review queue, and the Vertex prompt schema (with explicit instruction not to copy the same value across weapons of a given type). 2 new tests, go build/vet/test ./... clean. Redeployed the live IDUNA instance, live-verified. Commit b225175.

⚓ ☃
title: GFD Item Builder: real Delay field wired into GUI + batch-propose prompt
